semiconductor_relevance: Low — HERMLE Maschinenbau GmbH primarily focuses on metal additive manufacturing and does not directly supply semiconductor-specific products or services.
summary: HERMLE Maschinenbau GmbH specializes in metal additive manufacturing as a service, leveraging their patented MPA technology to produce multi-material components. Their capabilities include the integration of various materials to enhance thermal conductivity and wear resistance, which may have applications in various industries, including semiconductor manufacturing.
